I’m made with coffee seed oil to help soften, smooth and perk up your pout. Squalane delivers lightweight hydration and lanolin swoops in to seal the deal. I’ll keep your pout soft, nourished and naturally plump, with a delicious vanilla latte scent that’ll have you coming back for another swipe (or smooch).

title: Grab My (Rose)Hips Kit
body_html: First scrub, then rub, then let me see your hips swing. This powerful duo is here to heal, fade, and brighten. My 2-in-1 scrub in a tub exfoliates and melts into a nourishing lather. My dry body oil delivers hydration without the stickiness to leave you bright and restored. Get ready to celebrate hip-grabbingly good skin.

title: Original Lip Balm
body_html: Quite possibly the world’s best balm. My original Lip Balm is multi-purpose, made with clean ingredients (and no petroleum) to hydrate lips, cuticles, brows, and dry patches all day long. Use me pre- or post-kiss and let my blend of coffee seed oil, vitamin E, and lanolin smooth, repair and protect for your plumpest pout yet.

title: The Snatched Tool Kit
body_html: Your body routine doesn’t need to be hard. But it can be firm. My triple-charged Firming Body Cream formula smooths down, tones up, and can help reduce the appearance of dimpled skin for a visibly firm result. Pair it with my Body Sculpting Tool to help boost circulation and drain excess fluid retention, and you’ve got an at-home lymphatic massage that sulpts, tones, and firms up quicker than you can say “f**k squats”.

title: The Squat Drop Kit
body_html: Step into my firming wheelhouse, where sculpting, toning, and smoothing out dimples is my bread & butter. Harnessing the perking power of caffeine, guarana, and natural oils, my firming routine is your excuse to ditch the gym and hit the showers. Use my hero scrub to exfoliate, followed by my triple-charged Firming Body Cream. Boost the punch by adding Booty Drops to the mix for extra slip to massage with my Body Sculpting Tool.

title: Hit the Spot Kit
body_html: Buckle up for the smoothest trip of your life. My kit of bump-busting tricks and treats has been kitted out to give you the full acid treatment for less dough. Wash, scrub, and smooth with my best-selling acid formulas that banish bumps, tell bacne to back off, and chuck out chicken skin.

title: Triple Acid Body Duo
body_html: If I was into sports, I’d say this was a three-point bump shot. My two highly active high-performers are paired up in this kit to clear your skin of breakouts, keep skin balanced, and improve skin texture and tone. A body wash to clean the pores and actively remove dead skin cells, a body mist to use whenever you feel like targeting the peskiest of spots. I’m the ultimate triple threat for clear skin.

title: The Full Acid Drop Kit
body_html: Buckle up for the smoothest trip of your life. My suite of bump-busting tricks and treats have been kitted out to give you the full acid treatment for less dough. Wash, scrub, treat and smooth with my best-selling acid formulas that banish bumps, tell bacne to back off, and kick out KP.

title: Barrier Bodyguards Kit
body_html: Whether you’re feeling bone-dry, or the skin’s acting a little bitchy. I’ll protect you from the weather, and soothingly relieve the itchy. Ceramides bulk up your barrier. Jojoba oil is omega-rich. And vitamin B5 protects and serves. Lusciously foam up the wash, then lather on the creme to seal in the cracks. From the bottom (layer) to the top, I’m your personal nourisher, bouncer, protector. No buff, but all tough - bring in my barrier bodyguards.

title: Gentle Cleansing Oil
body_html:
Face full of makeup and nowhere to go (except bed)? Meet my Gentle Cleansing Oil. I’m a natural cleansing oil made with grapeseed & coffee oils, and vitamin E to remove and melt makeup (and hearts) while plumping your skin. I start out oily when applied to dry skin, then transform into a milky liquid texture when mixed with water. Use me AM or PM to break down dirt, makeup and winged-eyeliner attempts. I’ll leave skin feeling smooth, looking bright and panda-eye free.

Tip: Use me in the PM followed by my Clearing Face Wash for extra clear skin.

title: Super Ceramide Night Cream
body_html: I’m a rich moisturiser that plumps your skin and restores your skin’s barrier (the top layer that seals in moisture). When your skin feels irritated, dull, angry, and breakout-prone, ceramides will save the day. Use me before you get the “you up?” text and after applying your favourite serums. Awaken with luminous, juicy skin.

title: Cacao Coffee Scrub
body_html:
Chocolate as a fix for dry skin? You’re welcome. My Cacao Coffee Scrub is like a sweet kiss for even the driest skin, made with antioxidant-rich organic cacao extract to nourish and soften skin. This vegan and natural scrub uses coffee grinds and cold-pressed oils to give your skin a healthy glow everyone will want a piece of.

Pssst babe. Heads up, I contain nuts.

title: Triple Acid Body Wash
body_html: Wash off chicken skin, acne, and toxic exes. I'm a blend of three blemish-fighting acids that tackle the first signs of body breakouts and the marks they leave behind. I break down dead skin, remove impurities and fight inflammation which means I also battle the little bumps that pop up on your arms and legs. A triple threat for clear skin, I’m the most active shower you can have (wink).

title: Magnesium Body Scrub
body_html: When you’ve been burning the candle at both ends, unwind my top and awaken skin fatigue. Mineral-rich magnesium melts muscles and calms inflammation, while polishing salts buff and brighten skin to reveal a babe who definitely didn’t scroll until 2 am. Night-cap it off with soothing chamomile extract, jojoba oil, and calendula flower extract for a sleepy, smooth skin finish that will send you into REM land. Follow it up with my Body Therapy Oil for a double dose of chill.

title: Original Coffee Scrub
body_html:
Meet my Original Coffee Scrub: the one that made me famous. I’m 100% natural, vegan, and ready to work my magic on breakouts, scars, cellulite, stretch marks, eczema and psoriasis. My blend of coffee, vitamin E, and antioxidant-rich oils keep your skin looking perky, even, and oh so smooth. Enough introductions. Time to get naked.

Pssst babe. Heads up, I contain nuts.

title: Original Face Scrub
body_html:
For babes that only have one minute to get their glow on, meet my Original Face Scrub. I’m a caffeinated facial scrub made to clear pores, buff away dry skin & breakout-causing impurities, and nourish while I go. My blend of exfoliating white clay and famous coffee grinds mix with brightening rosehip oil to get skin glowing in a matter of seconds. For best results, use me 2-3 times a week after cleansing and before moisturising.

Tip: Use me followed by my Glow Mask to perfect your makeup prep.

title: Niacinamide Deodorant
body_html: I'll keep your pits super smooth and smelling like fresh berries (yum). Glide me on daily and let my blend of antioxidant-rich berry extracts, barrier-loving niacinamide and cyperus rotundus (aka regrowth fighter) do the dirty work for you. Neutralising actives trap odour at the source, while natural deodorisers absorb excess moisture to keep your underarms dry and fresh (without aluminum salts). I'll smooth underarm texture, replenishes dull skin and keep odour in check. Go on babe, take a bite swipe.

title: Ceramide Deodorant
body_html: For pits that are flaky, shaky and a little breaky. My ceramide and niacinamide blend helps support your skin barrier and lock in moisture, while hyaluronic acid keeps underarms feeling hydrated, smooth and silky all day long. Neutralising actives trap odour at the source, while natural deodorisers absorb excess moisture to keep your underarms dry and fresh. Grapefruit seed oil brings the zesty energy, packing an antioxidant punch and keeping pits fruity fresh. I smooth, soften, and keep BO at bay - without any aluminum salts. Glide me on daily to keep pits juicy (in a good way) and smelling like sweet peaches.

title: Caffeine Deodorant
body_html: Perk up tired pits with a double shot of caffeine. Packed with antioxidant-rich coffee seed oil, I help soften skin and keep BO at bay (without aluminium salts). Neutralising actives trap odour at the source, while natural deodorisers absorb excess moisture to keep your underarms dry and fresh. Shea and cacao butters bring out my soft side, nourishing delicate underarms and helping to lock in moisture without feeling greasy. Swipe me on daily to keep those pits perky, touchably soft and smelling sweeter than a vanilla latte.

title: AHA Deodorant
body_html: Tell bumps and ingrowns to beat it. My blend of glycolic acid, salicylic acid and mandelic acid work overtime to tackle pesky pit problems. Glycolic acid helps prevent odour-causing bacteria, while salicylic and mandelic acid step in for backup. Niacinamide joins the party to help keep things balanced, while shea butter swoops in to soften delicate underarms. Swipe me on daily to fight odour and leave pits feeling dry, smooth and minty fresh - no aluminium salts here.

title: Rosehip Dry Body Oil
body_html: I like my oils, jokes and martinis the same: dry. Tackle uneven skin, protect your moisture barrier, and keep your skin hydrated without the stickiness. I might be a tease but I’m never tacky. The power of rosehip oil brightens your skin and rejuvenates your curves. The hips don’t lie, babe.

title: Coconut Coffee Scrub
body_html: Vacation-glowing skin? Right this way, babe. My Coconut Coffee Scrub is natural and vegan, here to give your body a post-vacay glow all year round. With a gentle blend of exfoliating coffee grinds and caring essential oils like grapeseed and jojoba, I’ll work my magic on breakouts, scars, cellulite, and stretch marks. Go loco for my coconut scent while I buff and smooth dry skin to leave you as free as a palm tree.

title: Clearing Body Wash
body_html:
Buh-bye, body acne. There’s a new bodyguard in town. Made with blemish-busting salicylic acid, I go deep to slough off stubborn dead skin, reduce excess oil, and take out whiteheads and blackheads for good. I’m hydrating, vegan and soap-free, with clean anti-acne ingredients to remove impurities like sweat and dirt. Made with Kakadu plum, hydrating aloe vera and vitamin B to brighten and care for your skin.

(New packaging, same 5 star formula).

For every Body Wash purchased I’m donating one to Look Good Feel Better to help patients face cancer with confidence.

Psst. I'm made with 50% Post-Consumer Recycled material.

title: Clearing Face Scrub
body_html: Done with zits? Loud and clear. Pumice and salicylic acid work together to physically and chemically exfoliate, clear away impurities, and target blemishes. Niacinamide refines pores and calms inflammation when you’re seeing red. Scrub away dead skin dullness, leaving behind a brighter, smoother, and healthier-looking face.

title: Enzyme Face Cleanser
body_html: Complexion a bit complicated? Meet my fresh, foamy, flirty fruit salad of a face cleanser. Pineapple and papaya enzymes gently refine the skin with zingy exfoliants, while niacinamide smooths out uneven tone and bumps. Kaolin clay gives congestion a detox, and glycerin leaves the skin feeling juicy and anything but stripped. A cleansing way to get your two serves of fruit a day, I’m the ultimate palate cleanser.

title: Firming Body Cream
body_html: I’m firm on (actives)(dimples)(results). My tried, tested, trademarked, and triple-charged tub of toning helps reduce the visible appearance of cellulite and stretch marks, leaving skin feeling firmer as you sculpt. Just ask the 70 babes who tried me for six weeks. My supercharged ingredients pack a plump with a 3-in-1 skin enhancer that targets uneven skin texture for a smoother look. Pair with my Body Sculpting Tool for the ultimate circulation booster and at-home lymphatic massage.

title: Retinol Body Lotion
body_html:
When you feel like your skin is sluggish, dragging, and behind the times — hit the retinol rewind. I’m a gentle body lotion that packs a retinol punch and bursts with berry extracts by the bunch. Speed up cell turnover, plump it with peptides, and smooth it over with mango seed butter — from top (off) to toe.

PS: Always use me in conjunction with my SPF50+ Hydrating Body and Face Sunscreen, as retinol can make your skin more sensitive to the sun’s rays..

title: Original Lip Scrub
body_html: A good lip scrub for bad babes. I’m a cherry-scented lip scrub that removes flaky bits and plumps lips up. My blend of exfoliating sugar, plumping coffee seed oil & grapefruit extract, and hydrating ethically-sourced beeswax prepare lips for whatever comes next (kissing or lipstick, babe). Use me 2-3 times a week or whenever you want smooth lips, the juicy way.

title: In Your Dreams Sleep Scrub & Soak
body_html: #letsbefrank, sleep is the best beauty hack. To help you get some (sleep, babe) say hello to In Your Dreams. I’m a 2-in-1 scrub and soak, packed with soothing magnesium and gently exfoliating epsom salts to relieve sore muscles and smooth dry skin. My relaxing blend of lavender oil and chamomile help reduce cortisol levels and melt away tension. Mess-free because you don’t need the stress of cleaning me up, perfect for the bath or shower. I’m made without caffeine, making me the perfect goodnight kiss for your body and mind.

title: Clearing Body Scrub
body_html: This clay-based body scrub is a masterclass in sweeping away dead skin and cleaning out blocked pores. With a fine pumice exfoliant that doesn’t rile up active breakouts, I’m also packed with purifying white clay, refining salicylic acid, smoothing niacinamide and calming willow bark to manage oil and redness. Hit the red light on breakouts.

title: Body Therapy Oil
body_html: Overworked and fatigued? Drop it. I’ve bottled a blend of silky oils, healthy perspective, and skin-nourishing extracts to reverse dull, dry skin and intrusive thoughts. Chamomile extract calms the skin and mind, while my rich orchestra of oils — like sweet almond, jojoba, avocado, and sea buckthorn — lull you to sleep before you can even reach for your vibe. Pair this with my Magnesium Body Scrub for a double dose of melting muscles.

title: Body Sculpt Tool
body_html: Gua sha-re your body toning secrets, please. You don’t need to take out a loan to get a stimulating, invigorating, seriously-slimming lymphatic massage. Sculpt your way to smooth skin by liberally applying any of my body creams, serums, or oils so that the skin has some slip to it, and then use my tool to glide over the skin in upward strokes. Focus on areas where you’d like to reduce the appearance of dimpled skin and cellulite to increase blood flow and circulation.

title: Balancing Peptide Moisturiser
body_html: Manifesting resilient, glowy, bouncy skin? Get your game face on with my lightweight Balancing Peptide Moisturiser. I’ve packed in 5x the peptides to actively hydrate and strengthen your barrier, boost collagen, plump up fine lines, and balance oil production. I’m also flexing niacinamide and watermelon water for texture and tone, caffeine to perk up the ultimate makeup-base glow, and squalane for a hydrating nightcap.

title: Barrier Body Creme
body_html: Ceramides so repairing they could heal your ex. When skin’s acting shaky, flaky, and breaky, my Barrier Body Creme is the rich hydrator to drench dry skin and build your barrier. Packed full of ceramides, panthenol and niacinamide, I’m the creamy and dreamy tub full of thirst traps. Rebalance the scales with your personal nourisher, bouncer, and protector. I play well with your favourite actives because I balance and repair with tough, barrier-loving ingredients while actives and exfoliants use buff stuff to polish the skin..

title: Ceramide Barrier Body Wash
body_html: My Ceramide Barrier Body Wash will let dry jokes fly, but not dry skin. Cleanse your way to softer, juicy, stronger skin with my blend of ceramides, Vitamin B5 and fatty acids. I'm all tough, no buff, and designed to lather you up and rinse away the day while building up your barrier and protecting skin that's a bit emotional..

title: Triple Acid Body Mist
body_html:
Bending over backwards to get rid of bumps? I’m a lightweight blemish-busting and pigment-punishing mist with triple the actives to help clear pores and keep skin balanced. No spot goes unmist, which means you can reach any area prone to breakouts, ingrown hairs, or KP without any residue.

No shower? Mist opportunity. This featherlight formula is easy to layer with other products too, so you never have to choose between clear skin and your favourite body hydrator.

title: Niacinamide Correcting Body Serum
body_html: Correct me if I’m wrong, but I think I’m about to be all over you. Meet my Niacinamide Correcting Body Serum, an antioxidant rich body serum designed for everyday use to fight the signs of ageing including uneven skin tone, loss of elasticity and general dullness. My lilac serum rubs in clear and dries quickly so there is no heaviness or tackiness left behind. Bonus? I also tackle breakouts and the marks they leave behind. From top to toe, I’ll keep you soft and smooth, whilst fighting environmental damage that ages skin. Rewind the clock and watch skin elasticity bounce back, just like your ex.

title: Niacinamide Body Scrub
body_html: Fight the first signs of the times with my whipped, skincare-grade formula that future-proofs all over. Rich in antioxidants to wind back the clock, while a berry hue and scent winds down the day. With gentle foaming exfoliation, and an up-in-the-clouds texture, I’m the perfect scrub for babes who want stronger skin elasticity but don’t love using acids all the time. Packed with niacinamide, berry extracts and green tea, I put irritation to bed and rewind the clock to reveal smoother, brighter, healthier skin.

title: Clearing Gel Moisturiser
body_html:
An oil free, featherlight serum for acne prone skin. Made with super soothing and calming ingredients to help to tackle active breakouts while protecting and hydrating the skin barrier. Because hydrated skin is happy skin. Willow Bark, known as the natural source of salicylic acid, gently exfoliates and reduces oiliness, Zinc helps to prevent and target active breakouts while Niacinamide calms everything down and reduces redness.

Apply after cleansing morning and night.

title: Hyaluronic Acid Body Serum
body_html:
Whether you say baumy or balmy, I’m an ingredient army: Ceramides, Niacinamide and Hyaluronic Acid are a triple threat against a compromised skin barrier. Barrier repair doesn’t need to be thick and sticky, restore the hydration that is swept away by wind, blown away by heaters and gobbled up by acids with my lightweight gel-serum. Repair environmental damage, hydrate instantly and see the benefits of a dewy, nourishing serum for your body. No slip and stickiness, just high quality hydration for every skin type, just like the Hyaluronic Acid you put on your face. Because after all, why should your face have all the fun?

P.S. I work well in all seasons: layer me in winter and wear me alone in summer.

title: Super Ceramide Barrier Oil
body_html: Stressed skin not feeling it’s best? Meet your daily defense against dryness, breakouts, and skin sensitivity. I’m a lightweight, hydrating facial oil packed with ceramides, prickly pear oil and squalane to strengthen your barrier for (super) soothed skin. Use me daily prior to moisturising, or mix me with my Super Ceramide Night Cream for extra restoration to your barrier while you sleep. Stress less, babe. I’ve got you covered.

title: Brightening Body Wash
body_html:
Vitamin C: the skincare hero your body has been waiting for. Get even with this lightly foaming, brightening body wash packed with Kakadu Plum, Vitamin B5, Pomegranate to brighten and clarify for your complexion from top to toe. Feel illuminated and glowing; why should your face have all the fun?

Psst. I'm made with 50% Post-Consumer Recycled material.

title: Glycolic Body Scrub
body_html: Want mind-blowingly smooth skin? This is your solution to breakouts, keratosis pilaris (KP), bumps and dryness. Glycolic acid clears out the spot-causing stuff in your pores, and my exfoliating pumice buffs it down the drain. This combination of chemical and physical exfoliation delivers results (so you never have to fake it). Witch hazel and niacinamide soothe, calm, and tighten pores to help reduce acne and redness. Stop body spots with a no-mess formula and say yes, yes, yes to smooth, even skin.

title: Collagen Boost Serum
body_html:
I’m more than a vitamin C serum. I’m supercharged with ferulic acid, vitamin E, and hyaluronic acid to give your skin the cocktail it deserves. Together they’ll boost your collagen production for firmer, brighter, dewier skin. I’ll even out your skin tone, fight fine lines, and boost your radiance. No matter what you got up to last night. Can’t wait to C you, babe.

Pssst babe. I'm vegan.

title: Rosehip Body Scrub & Cleanser
body_html: I’m a scrub that melts into a cleanser, leaving your skin soft and smooth thanks to my blend of rosehip oil, coffee seed extract and lavender oil. Use me all over for silky, glowing skin and focus on areas prone to marks and scars to help soften and fade their appearance. Without erasing what makes you, you.  #letsbefrank

title: Charcoal Face Mask
body_html:
Looking to cut the drama from your skincare, babe? Meet my Charcoal Face Mask. I’m a calming face mask made with soothing chamomile, honey, and lavender. While you unwind, clogged pores will run for the hills thanks to my clearing charcoal and smoothing evening primrose oil. After cleansing, leave me on for 15 minutes and watch me work wonders on acne, irritation, and pores. Rinse me off and chill. That’s it – it’s a charcoal face mask, not your love life.

Formerly Anti-Drama Face Mask.

title: Smoothing AHA Body Lotion
body_html: Why should your face have all the fun? Meet my Smoothing AHA Body Lotion. I’m a mess-free, chemical body exfoliant for skin so ultra smooth, your clothes just might slip off. Oops. I’m made with lactic and glycolic acids to gobble up dead skin, help clear body breakouts and keratosis pilaris (KP), and hydrate at the same time. Apply me on rough spots or all over and let my brightening A-beauty ingredients like Emu Bush, Quandong and Kakadu Plum extracts help even skin tone to get you glowing. Together with hydrating oils and deeply nourishing mango seed butter, I’m a lightweight and non-sticky body lotion for skin that’s softer than a baby’s bum.

title: Rewind Retinol Serum
body_html: Let me take you back, babe. To a time before fine lines and wrinkles. Before breakouts and scars. I’m a gentle yet effective retinol serum made with 1% retinol blend to help rewind time and reduce breakouts. I’m the full package when it comes to active skincare, designed to help improve skin texture and fade lines with continued use. I’m non-irritating and vegan, made with Vitamin B and antioxidants. Likes: fading fine lines, spending time with you. Dislikes: scary movies.

title: Hydrating Hyaluronic Acid Serum
body_html: I’m a tall drink of water for your skin. Commit to me and watch your breakouts run for the hills and your complexion start glowing. Parents love me, but after I plump up your skin and keep oils at bay, you’ll want to keep me all to yourself. I’m vegan, lightweight, easy to integrate into any routine and always come through, babe. No matter your (skin) type, use me morning and evening or under makeup and I’ll be the hydrating influence your life has been missing. Your skin is thirsty for me, #letsbefrank.

title: Booty Drops Firming Oil
body_html:
Ready to pop that booty? Meet my Booty Drops Firming Oil. Like an energy drink for your skin, I’m made with firming caffeine, hydrating carrot root extract, and antioxidant-rich guarana to perk your favourite ass-et right up. Grapeseed and jojoba oils will soften skin and get you glowing. Drop me straight onto your booty for supple skin or mix me with your moisturiser for extra perks.

Tip: Mix me with my Perky Hydrator for a double shot of caffeine.

title: Brightening Vitamin C Mask
body_html: Ready to get active with your skincare? My Brightening Vitamin C Mask is a multitasking active face mask, made with vit C-rich Kakadu Plum to reveal your brightest glow. I gobble up dead skin cells with papaya & pineapple extract and glycolic acid. My salicylic acid goes deep into pores to clear them out. Lactic acid hydrates and plumps to keep skin juicy. I’m a gentle yet effective exfoliant with a sophisticated formula and a down to earth price tag. I only take 5 minutes every 2-3 days to work my magic on hyperpigmentation, scarring, and fine lines.

title: Cherry Bomb Lip Scrub
body_html: A good lip scrub for bad babes. I’m a cherry-scented lip scrub that removes flaky bits and plumps lips up. My blend of exfoliating sugar, plumping coffee seed oil & grapefruit extract, and hydrating ethically-sourced beeswax prepare lips for whatever comes next (kissing or lipstick, babe). Use me 2-3 times a week or whenever you want smooth lips, the juicy way.

title: Taupeless Lip Tint
body_html: My Taupe-less Lip Tint will make you blush. Use me on-the-go to give lips and cheeks a natural flush of colour and dewy shine. My blend of coffee seed and coconut oils hydrate and plump, while lanolin and ethically-sourced beeswax hydrate and help colour stay put. Smooth not sticky, meet your new multi-purpose handbag essential, babe.

title: Cherry Bomb Lip Tint
body_html:
You’re already a babe. This is the cherry on top. My Cherry Bomb Lip Tint gives a flush of rosy colour and subtle gloss to lips and cheeks. I keep skin smooth with a hydrating blend of coffee seed and coconut oils, lanolin and ethically-sourced beeswax. My pinky-red hue and juicy cherry scent make me a pre-kiss essential. Time to pucker up, babe.

Tip: Build up colour by adding me in layers.

title: Glow Mask
body_html: Didn’t get enough last night? Sleep, babe. Meet my Glow Mask. I’m a natural, ultra-hydrating face mask made to reduce puffiness and get you glowing (fast). I’m packed with antioxidant-rich goji berry extract, deeply hydrating shea & cocoa butter, and de-puffing coffee seed oil to give extra life to tired skin. Use me pre-makeup, post-late nights or morning afters. The best part? I only take 5 minutes to work my magic. Time for your glow-up, babe.
